description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by bnd-0036. On WebMCP every tool carries the floor as annotation hints — readOnlyHint on search/read/links/compose/ask, consequentialHint on propose/remember, untrustedContentHint on every prose-returning tool — and on MCP the extension id com.agenticsystemcore/knowledge is advertised in the capabilities.extensions member returned by server/discover.
note: added 2026-09-17 at rc.3 (DS-5, deferred-vector pass); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (RC5-C; RC5-B Q-RC5B-1, SPEC-ITEMS-FOR-1.0.0 item 30 / RC5B-01). This file states `expected.mcp["server/discover"].capabilities.extensions` as the identifier ARRAY ["com.agenticsystemcore/knowledge"] — the shape the reference engine returned before rc.5, which no rule ever pinned. AGSC-11-18 as amended at rc.5 (V9A-04, SITE1-01) makes that member MCP's own map of extension identifiers to per-extension settings objects, with exactly one member, `linkset`, in this extension's object. Model Context Protocol, "Versioning and Compatibility" for revision 2026-07-28, read 2026-09-21: "Extensions are advertised in the `extensions` field of capabilities, which is a map of extension identifiers to per-extension settings objects." A required vector and its rule stated two different shapes for one published surface, and the conformance handler could satisfy both only by reading what this file names as the map's key set — a reading, not a pin, and a reader of this file alone still saw the wrong shape. Superseded by bnd-0036, which carries the same case with `site.base` stated in `input`, the webmcp half verbatim, and the capability stated as the map.
